expectations.text: Loads the Timer A latch at $DC04/$DC05
expectations.evidence: STA $DC04 (Timer A latch LO) and STA $DC05 (Timer A latch HI)

expectations.text: Enables the Timer A interrupt in the ICR $DC0D (with bit 7 set to mark 'set', bit 0 for timer A)
Starts the timer via control register A $DC0E (with continuous reload)
expectations.evidence: LDA #%00010001 / STA $DC0E with bit0 START, bit3=0 continuous reload

expectations.text: Acknowledges/handles by reading $DC0D in the IRQ handler
expectations.evidence: newirq: LDA $DC0D ; READ+CLEAR CIA1 ICR -> ack
